about: QR Palette settings. Edit with any text editor while the program is closed. A setting that is left out or not valid uses its default (see settings.example.json and README.md). registry: the SQLite file of QR codes; empty means the program's data folder.

pictures.about: Where new QR codes are saved and how they are drawn. folder: empty means Pictures\QR Palette. pixels_per_module: the PNG scale. error_correction: L, M, Q or H.

colors.about: preset: the ranking in presets/ (mixer, balanced, popular, discover, or your own). minimum_contrast: the WCAG contrast against white a color needs to be offered (3.0 keeps 118 of the 216). near_distance: how close in OKLab counts as near. rankings_folder: the folder that holds presets/ and weights/; empty means beside the program.

inference.about: The local model server: http on 127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost only. model: the default model for ecp_query when a client passes no model_id, and the one the window selects at start; empty means a client must choose. require_cloud_disabled: refuse to plan unless the server reports its cloud features off (set OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1 for Ollama); turning it off lets a signed-in server reach the internet. Times are in seconds: timeout_seconds for --ecp and --mcp, window_timeout_seconds for the window's Ask. max_answer_tokens and retry_answer_tokens: room for a plan, and for one retry when it is cut off.

planner.about: How plain-English questions become query plans: the model's rules, worked examples and color words. file: empty means planner.json beside the program.

links.about: Short links: links.json holds their two sections (local and nonlocal), the ID length, the tags added to destinations and the link templates. file: empty means links.json beside the program. use: which section new short links use, local (this computer or your own network) or nonlocal (your internet address); the Make tab switches it.

queries.about: How many results an answer holds, how long a question may be, and how long one read of the registry may take before it is stopped.

protocol.about: Limits for ECP's MCP server: the longest message line; tool calls per second and the burst allowed; the most characters of a link or path in a result, and of a whole result (rows are dropped from the end to fit, and truncated is set).

audit.about: The audit log: one JSON line per ECP call, each holding the SHA-256 of the line before, so any change shows. file: empty means audit.jsonl in the program's data folder.
